title: Jalon Daniels: Fast start gave us confidence we could win the game

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jalon Daniels: Fast start gave us confidence we could win the game
sources.description: Quarterback Jalon Daniels and the Buccaneers came into Dallas as big underdogs on Thursday night and the first Cowboys possession of the night did little to suggest oddsmakers had it wrong.
